scenarios.name: bo-1440
scenarios.first_frame_text:
Bo withholds assent: no positive assent is recorded

Recorded policy input through native interpretation and installed mechanics. Other actors wait.

Original words
I withhold assent to activation by recording my position as not assenting.
Interpretation

No matching installed operation. The attempt is to record a non-assenting position, but record-assent does not express that negative position and no other kind represents recording it.

Field	Represented object	Quoted words
No action field binding; the attempted non-assent is not positive assent.
Consequence

Bo remains not assenting. The judge proposes no new rule and no world state changes.
